parameters.name: FailedRuleTemplate
parameters.description: The filter for rules with failed scores.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: If the value is not set or is less than 10, the default value is 10. If the value is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. If there is a next page, this field has a return value. If this parameter returns data, a next page exists. Use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data. Repeat until the return value is Null, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

parameters.name: ResourceArn
parameters.description: The resource ARN. You can specify multiple resource ARNs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceCategoryId
parameters.description: The resource category ID. You can specify multiple resource category IDs separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. For example, if the resource to query is an instance, this parameter can be understood as the InstanceId.

parameters.name: ResourceOwnerIds
parameters.description: The list of resource owner IDs. This parameter is used in cross-account scenarios. If left empty, data of the current account is retrieved by default.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: ASC (ascending) and DESC (descending).
